name: AP Cad/Cam 1.0.0
body:
## AP Cad/Cam 1.0.0

- The app is now called AP Cad/Cam.
- New **Comment** button at the top right: send a Bug, a Feature request or an Improvement idea.
- New **Update** button: it appears at the top when a newer version is on this page.
- Includes all CAM work so far: tool library, mill and lathe setups, 2D and 3D milling, turning,
  boring, grooving and threading, simulation, checked Haas and Fanuc posts.

Test only: do not run its G-code on a machine until the machine settings are confirmed.
